response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, senior engineer with genuine high-throughput distributed systems experience (Dunnhumby) and is currently working hands-on with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which aligns well with the role's AI-native mindset. However, his resume shows no explicit Python experience despite it being a core must-have, and there is little direct evidence of formal stakeholder management, on-call/incident response, or agile ceremony participation, making it unclear he meets all must-have criteria without further probing.
strengths: Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Current role directly involves AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic developer tooling
Broad, multi-language technical range (DLang, TypeScript, C++, Java, etc.) with staff-level titles and strong systems-thinking evidence via talks/workshops
concerns: No Python listed anywhere in skills or work history, despite it being a must-have
Little explicit mention of stakeholder management, on-call rotations, or incident response ownership
Frequent job changes (many roles under 2 years) raise questions about tenure and depth of ownership at scale
